name: skill_catalog
description: Stella's skill catalog: the 'skill find' capability. Lists every skill available on this machine (features/ plus the user-data skills dir), finds skills by keyword, name, alias or trigger, installs a skill package from a local path or inline definition, registers a loaded skill into the dynamic registry, and runs a skill operation. Nothing is symlinked or referenced from outside this project - every installed skill is written into features/ or the user-data skills dir so Stella runs identically on any device. Installs and writes require authorized=true plus confirm=true plus a policy allow rule.

operation.description: One of: list | find | install | register | run | sources. Defaults to sources.

keyword.description: Keyword to search skills by (find operation).

path.description: Local path to a skill package directory or skill.py file to install (install operation).

name.description: Skill name to register or run.

skill.description: Alias for name: the skill to run (run operation).

operation_target.description: The skill operation to invoke (run operation), e.g. 'sources', 'count', 'list'.

args.description: JSON object of arguments to pass to the skill operation (run operation). Defaults to {}.

authorized.description: Must be true for install and any operation that writes to disk.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually install or register a skill.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 50.

author: Stella
notes: Writes skills only into features/ or the user-data skills dir - never symlinks or references a PC skill directory. Install/register are destructive (write to disk) and need authorized=true + confirm=true + an allow rule.
